issues.title: Build stage completed without emitting FACTORY_BUILD_JSON and harness captured no partial output
issues.symptom: "status": "BLOCKED", "reason": "build produced no FACTORY_BUILD_JSON" with buildSteps/buildNotes/verifyEvidence/verifyReasons all null
issues.repro: Run the weapon-sword rung's build stage in edit mode and inspect the cycle record: the build agent's final message lacks the FACTORY_BUILD_JSON line and the harness stores nulls instead of any transcript/partial notes, leaving retro blind to the failure cause.

issues.title: Lighting.Technology not settable at PluginSecurity
issues.symptom: Technology property was locked (PluginSecurity) - left at place default
issues.repro: In edit mode, call set_property on game.Lighting Technology (e.g. Future) and observe the write is refused due to plugin security level

issues.title: playtest_eval unusable when place has LoadStringEnabled off
issues.symptom: playtest_eval unavailable (LoadStringEnabled off) so interaction verified by script read only
issues.repro: Open a place with ServerScriptService.LoadStringEnabled=false, playtest_start, then call playtest_eval with any code - it cannot execute, leaving no way to probe runtime state during the playtest.

issues.title: Playtest cannot simulate GUI button clicks
issues.symptom: runtime click injection blocked by plugin capability (VIM requires RobloxScript)
issues.repro: Start a playtest with a ScreenGui containing a TextButton and attempt to inject a click on it via the playtest driver (VirtualInputManager) at PluginSecurity; the injection is refused, forcing handler verification by source read only.

issues.title: Iteration cap terminates build stage without salvaging any build record
issues.symptom: build produced no FACTORY_BUILD_JSON; transcript tail: (iteration cap reached — the work so far is applied; run again to continue)
issues.repro: Run a build rung whose work exceeds the per-turn iteration cap (e.g. weapon-sword with full grip/anim/hitbox loop); the harness stops the turn at the cap and the cycle records BLOCKED with null buildSteps/evidence instead of resuming or capturing a partial record.
